shortDesc: VS Code extension for viewing, testing, and submitting CSES solutions.
fullDesc:
A custom VS Code extension designed to bring the popular CSES (Computer Science Educational Submissions) Problem Set directly into the development environment.

Core Idea:
Instead of switching between the browser and the text editor, this extension loads problem descriptions in a side panel inside VS Code, automatically runs code against local test cases, and submits solutions directly to the CSES online judge platform using secure API integration.
highlights: Integrated panel to read CSES problem statements
Local test suite execution with side-by-side input/output diffing
Automated session-based submission flow directly from the editor
